rationale: Sotomayor, as the most senior justice in the majority, would likely assign the opinion to herself or Kagan given their strong articulation of the core Atkins-incorporation argument, with Barrett being a candidate for a narrower concurrence addressing the Pinholster remand concern. The dissenters — particularly Thomas and Alito — are highly likely to write separately given their strong views on AEDPA deference and the Pinholster record limitation, while Gorsuch and Barrett may write separately to address the appropriate scope of remand instructions.
